analysis.scoreReason: RSI 중립 구간 횡보, MACD 개선 둔화
analysis.scoreReasonEn: RSI neutral range consolidation, MACD improvement slowing
analysis.reason: 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI는 과매수 구간에서 냉각 중이며, MACD 히스토그램은 약세로 전환되어 악화되고 있다. 가격은 볼린저밴드 중단 부근에서 횡보하며 방향성 부재를 보인다. 5일 평균 거래량 비율 0.97로 움직임에 힘이 실리지 않아 추가적인 방향성 확인이 필요하다.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive trading days. RSI is cooling from overbought territory, and the MACD histogram has turned negative and is worsening. Price is consolidating around the Bollinger Band middle line, showing a lack of directional momentum. The 5-day average volume ratio of 0.97 indicates a lack of conviction in the current movement, necessitating further directional confirmation.

· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation): Entry for buy on recovery of swing support ($2,387.61) and RSI above 50 confirmation, entry for sell on continued MACD bearishness below swing resistance ($2,462.8)
